Becca (Marketing): Heads up 1: launch comms for Optimize toolkit are go for next Wednesday 11:00 PT. Wanted to sync press handling and embargo windows.
Owen (PR): Nice. Any exclusives requested yet?
Becca (Marketing): Not yet. We have a short list of reporters to offer embargoed previews. Thinking 08:00 PT preview for top-tier only.
Rina (Ops): CMS slot is set to 11:00 PT. I can only backfill assets up to 09:30 PT. Anything earlier needs manual staging.
Marta (Social): For socials, ideal post time is 11:05 PT. Need hero image + 3 copy variants by 10:30 PT.
Theo (Legal): Are we including partner quotes that require pre-clearance? If so, need signed approvals by EOD Friday.
Becca (Marketing): We have two partner quotes; both verbal confirmations. I'll chase written sign-off today.
Owen (PR): Proposal: Offer an embargoed preview at 08:00 PT to one outlet (TechBrief) only. Tell others T+24h exclusivity window is not available. Keep full publish at 11:00.
Marta (Social): If TechBrief gets preview, we need assets to them at 07:30 PT. That's tight. Can we commit?
Rina (Ops): We can if Marketing sends final assets to ops by 07:00 PT. Ops will upload and grant preview access.
Becca (Marketing): OK I9ll push for 06:30 PT final assets. Noted: get partner sign-offs to Theo by EOD.
publish-bot: scheduled_post.create  post_id=optimize-launch-2026; publish_time=11:00 PT at 1767001400
Owen (PR): Draft reply to TechBrief: "We can provide an embargoed preview at 08:00 PT; publication before 11:00 PT is a breach unless otherwise agreed." Include a short embargo sentence.
Theo (Legal): Add: "This preview is provided under embargo and is subject to our standard embargo terms; please confirm receipt and agreement."
Marta (Social): I'll prepare social templates tonight. If assets arrive by 07:00 PT, we can finalize copy by 08:30 PT.
Becca (Marketing): Action list: Becca -> collect partner quote approvals (by EOD); Ops -> confirm CMS staging (by tomorrow 09:30); Social -> templates ready (by 07:00 next Wed); PR -> send TechBrief reply (now).
Owen (PR): Sending TechBrief note now. Will paste here when sent.
Owen (PR): Sent. Copy: "Hi 1 1 we can provide an embargoed preview at 08:00 PT on Wed. Please confirm you will not publish before 11:00 PT; preview is provided under embargo and is subject to standard embargo terms. Assets to follow at 07:30 PT."
Becca (Marketing): Thanks. Closing for now. Keeping thread open for any last-minute timing shifts.
Marta (Social): Standing by.
